visualCharacteristics.purpose: Translucent link boxes (icon, title, text, pill link) over a full-bleed background photo
notes: Full-bleed mountain photo behind three translucent dark glass boxes; each box: white line icon, uppercase h3, short text, outline pill "Find out more" with arrow. Becomes a dot-paginated slider on mobile. The photo background belongs to the block, so the section is not colored (visual-trees records #f3efe5 under the photo).

contentPattern.structure: optional first single-cell row = background image; then one row per box: cell 1 = icon image, cell 2 = h3 + text + link
patterns: optional first single-cell row = background image
icon + h3 + text + outline pill link
blockContent: 3 boxes (Our Name, Our Leadership, Our Values), each icon + h3 + text + Find out more link to an about detail page; full-bleed background photo

usage.description: Three to four section entry points (e.g. about sub-pages) laid over a landscape photo; slider with dots on mobile.

reuseGuidance: Use for icon + title + link boxes over a photo. Use cards for a plain grid of image cards, cards-slider for tall photo cards.
